name: Machine Learning
description: Nature of intelligence and learning; statistical foundations and the frequentist-Bayesian divide; notions of tasks, models, and features; linear regression and classification models; kernels and SVMs; decision trees and random forests; naive Bayes, logistic regression, and neural networks; key advances in modern deep learning; k-means, Gaussian mixture models, EM algorithm; PCA and autoencoders; basics of statistical learning theory.
